schema: Machine-readable ownership per Master Spec Section 11. Fields: path, owner, readers, writers, protected, purpose. Intentionally incomplete at Phase 0 - bots/blacktide and bots/claude don't exist until Phase 11+, so this file is a schema plus what concretely exists today. Each later phase must add its own new paths' ownership entries here rather than this file guessing them in advance.
rule: Claude cannot modify BLACKTIDE-private resources. ChatGPT/Codex cannot modify Claude-private resources. Neither competitor autonomously changes immutable competition law.

entries.purpose: Approved architecture, goals, and rules. Agents follow it; only the owner edits it (Section 24).
Cross-agent collaboration contract and control-hub field reference.
Shared exclusive-lock/checkpoint/finish/verify tool; the required locking/concurrency mechanism for Phase 0 (Section 12).

PROJECT_STATE/PHASES/ACTIVE_HANDOFF/CHANGELOG/OWNERSHIP/IMMUTABLE_RULES - the single shared source of project truth per Section 13. Writes should go through ai_coordination.py's begin/checkpoint/finish, not direct edits. Phase 4 landed enforcement: finish() calls enforce_ownership() against this file before releasing the lock, and verify() calls validate_governance_schema()/check_state_freshness() against these files before allowing a new begin().

Phase 10 (Section 15): the 43-chapter curriculum's stable structure - chapter list, lc-NN-slug Discord channel naming, LC-XX-YY lesson IDs, and the lesson registry. Both agents may build/maintain the shell and tooling; Section 15 requires autonomous trading code to never import, search, or query this module or its content.

scoped_instructions_convention: Each BLACKTIDE_ONLY/CLAUDE_ONLY directory (created Phase 11+, e.g. bots/blacktide, bots/claude) must contain its own AGENTS.md scoped to that directory, following the nearest-file convention: an agent reads the root AGENTS.md plus the nearest scoped AGENTS.md above its working path. This file's writers field for that directory's entry is the authoritative machine-readable grant; the scoped AGENTS.md is a human/agent-readable restatement of the same rule, not a separate grant. Root AGENTS.md must not enumerate bot directories in advance of the phase that creates them.
not_yet_assigned: market/options/backtest/features/execution/api_budget/competition/events/discord (SHARED_CORE) - Phases 5-9 shipped these as flat root modules (market_data_store.py, market_data_collector.py, backtest_lab.py, market_api_budget.py, scoreboard.py, discord_surface_manifest.py, rivalry.py, etc.), matching this repo's existing convention, not the shared/ package originally anticipated here.
